description_en: Locks a virtual MFA device that is in Normal state
description_zh: 锁定处于正常（NORMAL）状态的虚拟MFA设备
kebab_example: aliyun ecd lock-virtual-mfa-device --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --serial-number a25f297f-f2e1-4a44-bbf1-5f48a6e50000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: LockVirtualMFADevice

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the virtual MFA device, which is also its unique identifier. You can call [DescribeVirtualMFADevices](~~DescribeVirtualMFADevices~~) to query the serial number of the virtual MFA device bound to an AD account
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟MFA设备的序列号，也是其唯一标识。您可以调用[DescribeVirtualMFADevices](~~DescribeVirtualMFADevices~~)查询AD账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备序列号
parameters.name: serial_number
